controles.affirmation: En juin 2026, la Cour supreme americaine a donne raison a Bayer sur le glyphosate
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026 (2026-08-04), Key Events : "In June, the US Supreme Court issued a 7:2 landmark ruling in the Durnell Roundup (active ingredient: glyphosate) case, affirming that the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) expressly preempts state-law-based failure-to-warn claims when the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has made a definitive determination on product safety."

controles.affirmation: Au S1 2026, sortie nette de 2 246 M€ pour regler des procedures judiciaires (PCB et glyphosate), dont 432 M€ verses dans un fonds fiduciaire
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026, Notes to the Statements of Cash Flows : "Payments to resolve legal proceedings, which primarily related to the PCB and glyphosate litigations, resulted in a net outflow of EUR 2,246 million (H1 2025: EUR 140 million). That figure included an amount of EUR 432 million that was paid into a trust fund as part of the class settlement to resolve current and future glyphosate claims."

controles.affirmation: Le reglement collectif prevoit des versements annuels plafonnes et degressifs pouvant atteindre 7,25 Mds $ sur 21 ans
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026 : "To fund the class, Monsanto will make declining capped annual payments for up to 21 years totaling up to US$7.25 billion."

controles.affirmation: L'accord ne devient definitif qu'apres epuisement de toutes les voies d'appel, ce qui pourrait prendre plusieurs annees
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026 : "The class settlement does not become final and effective until all appeal procedures have been concluded, which could take several years."

controles.affirmation: Monsanto conserve le droit de resilier l'accord si le nombre de desistements (opt-outs) est juge excessif
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026 : "Monsanto has the right to terminate the class settlement if the number of opt-outs is excessive."

controles.affirmation: Cinq procureurs generaux d'Etat (Delaware, Maine, Maryland, New Jersey, Vermont) poursuivent Monsanto pour PCB ; reglements anterieurs avec sept autres Etats pour environ 456 M$ ; Oregon regle seul pour 698 M$
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026 : "There are now five attorney general cases pending that claim damages related to PCB contamination of the state's environment: Delaware, Maine, Maryland, New Jersey and Vermont. Prior cases filed or threatened by Washington, Washington D.C., New Mexico, New Hampshire, Ohio, Pennsylvania and Virginia were settled for a combined total of approximately US$456 million. The cases filed or threatened by West Virginia, Illinois, Michigan, and Rhode Island were settled on mutually acceptable terms in December 2025 and May 2026, respectively. The company also settled a pending matter with the State of Oregon for US$698 million, reflecting unique circumstances in that State."
controles.correction_proposee: Imprecision mineure sans consequence : les sept juridictions du reglement a 456 M$ incluent Washington D.C., qui n'est pas un Etat. Ecrire "sept juridictions" plutot que "sept Etats" serait plus exact.

controles.affirmation: En avril 2026, Latham Quality a depose une action collective alleguant que Bayer a conspire illegalement pour restreindre la concurrence et monopoliser le marche americain des traits genetiques du mais, avec demande de dommages triples
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026 : "Corn seed antitrust litigation: In April 2026, the independent seed company Latham Quality, Inc. filed a class action complaint against Bayer in the United States... It alleges that Bayer unlawfully conspired to restrain trade and monopolized the United States market for genetically engineered corn seed traits through various allegedly anti-competitive practices. The complaint asserts violations of federal and Missouri antitrust laws... The plaintiff seeks treble damages, punitive damages, injunctive relief, and other remedies... Bayer believes it has meritorious defenses and intends to defend itself vigorously."

controles.affirmation: Dette financiere nette de 33 647 M€ au 30 juin 2026 (+3,5% vs 31 mars 2026, +1,1% sur un an) ; ratio de fonds propres 27,7% ; cible revisee a 29-30 Mds € contre 32-33 Mds € initialement
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026 : "Net financial debt (at end of period) 33,274 / 33,647 / +1.1" et tableau net financial debt 29,843 (Dec 2025) / 32,518 (Mar 2026) / 33,647 (Jun 2026) +3.5. "The equity ratio advanced to 27.7% as of June 30, 2026 (March 31, 2026: 26.8%)." CP S1 2026 : "Bayer has affirmed its currency-adjusted Group guidance for full-year 2026 for all metrics except net financial debt, which it now expects to come in lower than originally projected, at 29 to 30 billion euros (previous forecast: 32 to 33 billion euros)."

controles.affirmation: Provisions hors pensions de 14 278 M€ au 30 juin 2026 (9 095 non courantes + 5 183 courantes), contre 15 792 M€ fin 2025 et 11 558 M€ mi-2025, soit +23,5% vs juin 2025
controles.verbatim_source: RFS S1 2026, Bayer Group Condensed Consolidated Statements of Financial Position (B3), colonnes "June 30, 2025 | Dec. 31, 2025 | June 30, 2026". Noncurrent Other provisions : 7,483 / 8,976 / 9,095. Current Other provisions : 4,075 / 6,816 / 5,183. Totaux : 11 558 (juin 2025), 15 792 (dec 2025), 14 278 (juin 2026). Calcul : 14278/11558 = +23,5%.

controles.affirmation: Xarelto -42,4% et Eylea -32,8% (taux et perimetre constants) au T2 2026 ; Nubeqa +63,9%, Kerendia +82,9% ; ventes Pharmaceuticals 4,458 Mds € soit +0,8% (taux et perimetre constants)
controles.verbatim_source: CP S1 2026 (2026-08-04) : "Sales of prescription medicines (Pharmaceuticals) came in at 4.458 billion euros, in line with the prior year (Fx & portfolio adj. plus 0.8 percent)... Nubeqa sales advanced by 63.9 percent (Fx & portfolio adj.)... while the 82.9 percent (Fx & portfolio adj.) rise in Kerendia sales... After encountering headwinds from patent expirations, the oral anticoagulant posted a decline of 42.4 percent (Fx & portfolio adj.), while business with the ophthalmology drug decreased 32.8 percent (Fx & portfolio adj.)."

controles.affirmation: L'arrivee de biosimilaires est presentee comme la cause du recul d'Eylea
controles.verbatim_source: Le mot "biosimilar" n'apparait ni dans le CP S1 2026 ni dans le RFS S1 2026. Le CP attribue le recul de Xarelto ET d'Eylea a la meme cause generique : "After encountering headwinds from patent expirations..."
controles.correction_proposee: Point mineur et non trompeur sur le fond, mais l'attribution causale specifique aux biosimilaires n'est pas dans le document cite. Soit ecrire "apres expiration de brevets" pour les deux produits (formulation du CP), soit sourcer la mention biosimilaires ailleurs.

controles.affirmation: CA Xarelto 374 M€ (-42,5%), Eylea 573 M€ (-33,5%), Nubeqa 880 M€ (+61,2%) au T2 2026 ; baisse combinee ~-580 M€ contre hausse Nubeqa +334 M€
controles.verbatim_source: kpis-haut BAYN.DE : XARELTO value 374,0 yoy -42,5% (Q2-2025 = 650) ; EYLEA value 573,0 yoy -33,5% (Q2-2025 = 862) ; NUBEQA value 880,0 yoy +61,2% (Q2-2025 = 546). Calculs : recul Xarelto -276 M€ + recul Eylea -289 M€ = -565 M€ ; hausse Nubeqa +334 M€. Nubeqa (880) depasse bien Eylea (573) et Xarelto (374) ce trimestre.
controles.correction_proposee: Le "environ -580 M€" est en realite -565 M€. Ecart de 15 M€ couvert par le mot "environ", sans consequence sur la demonstration.

controles.affirmation: Dividende ramene a 0,11 € depuis l'exercice 2023, le minimum prevu par le droit allemand ; ROCE -0,1% en 2024 et -1,4% en 2025 contre +7,7% en 2022 et +10,8% en 2017
controles.verbatim_source: kpis-haut BAYN.DE, serie DIVIDEND : FY2017-FY2019 2,80 ; FY2020-FY2021 2,00 ; FY2022 2,40 ; FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 = 0,11. Serie ROCE : FY2017 10,8 ; FY2022 7,7 ; FY2023 0,7 ; FY2024 -0,1 ; FY2025 -1,4. URD FY2025 : "Proposed dividend of EUR 0.11 per share" et rapport du conseil de surveillance : "payment of a dividend of EUR 0.11 per share". La qualification "minimum legal allemand" n'est pas ecrite telle quelle dans les documents cites, mais elle est verifiable a partir d'eux : capital social 2 515 M€ / 982 424 082 actions = 2,56 € de nominal, dont 4% (minimum AktG §254) = 0,102 €, arrondi a 0,11 €.
